title: Pink Workwear for a Freezing Office
intro: Every office has one thermostat and it is set for penguins. This is the fix: a soft pink cable cardigan over wide leg trousers, loafers you can walk to the train in, and a tote that fits the laptop. Soft and pink was never the opposite of competent.

sections.heading: The cardigan does the heavy lifting
paragraphs: The light pink cable knit cardigan is the reason this outfit exists. Crew neck, button front, chunky cables. When the office hits penguin settings, button it all the way up and it looks just as intentional.

Cable knits run thicker than fine knits, so check the size chart on the listing and think about what goes under it. If you want room for a long sleeve tee, size up one. I have worn this cardigan buttoned to the neck in a July meeting while someone in short sleeves said it felt fine in there. It did not.

sections.heading: Trousers and loafers for the commute
paragraphs: That length matters. Wide legs that drag pick up every puddle on the walk in, and ones that are too short look like a mistake. Check the inseam on the listing and hem them if you need to. It is a cheap fix that makes them look custom.

The black leather penny loafers are the shoe I can walk to the train in and still wear to a presentation. Leather loafers can feel stiff for the first week. Wear them with thin socks around the house before the first real commute. Black keeps it grounded next to all the soft pink.

sections.heading: A tote that actually holds a laptop
paragraphs: Before you order, check the listing dimensions against your laptop, because some totes say laptop and mean small laptop.

The gold and pearl stud earrings are the low effort finish. Small, classic, and they go with every top you own, so you never think about earrings at seven in the morning again. They also do not snag on a cable knit collar the way dangles do, which I learned the hard way with a hoop and a very long video call. Pearls next to soft pink just look polished.

Tote care is easy. Wipe it down with a dry cloth, and if it gets rained on, let it dry away from the heater. Do not overstuff the side pockets or the shape slumps. I keep a charger, a lip balm and a snack in it and that is it, because a bag this size will quietly turn into a junk drawer if you let it.

sections.heading: The giant pink tumbler and everything else
paragraphs: The hot pink 40 oz insulated tumbler with a handle is huge. That is the point. Fill it with ice water in the morning and you are not walking to the break room six times. It is also the one loud pink thing in an otherwise quiet outfit, which is how I like it at work. Check the care notes on the listing before it goes in a dishwasher, and take the lid apart to wash it, because the straw is where the gunk hides.
Already own a pink sweater and neutral trousers? Start there and add the tumbler. This look is not seasonal. It works any month the thermostat is out to get you, which is all of them.
Everything in the styled and lifestyle photos that is not on the list, the pumpkins, mugs, lights and furniture, is styling extras, so use what you already own.
